summary: Created a 7-phase, 5-wave implementation plan for the manifest-declared topic/task_type-keyed post-task observer seam, integrating the research pass's re-measured insertion point (after persisted_status in orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh, superseding the dispatch's stale line estimate) and its resolve-all-vs-first-match-wins library boundary.
